```{r}
#| label: filter_practices
#| include: false

### join practice open dates to practice list size by code / practice
included_practice_status <- function() {
  df <- df_practice_open_info |>
    full_join(df_practice_list_size, by = join_by(code == practice)) |>
    ## create closed status by month
    ## close date is after end of month, join date is before month, leave_provider_date is after end of month)
    mutate(
      month_status = case_when(
        !is.na(close_date) & close_date <= rollforward(month) ~ "closed",
        (!is.na(join_provider_date) &
          join_provider_date >= month) ~ "not opened",
        !is.na(leave_provider_date) &
          (leave_provider_date <= rollforward(month)) ~ "left provider",
        .default = "open"
      )
    ) |>
    left_join(
      df_ccgs |> select(code, regional_team_id, stp_id),
      by = join_by(ccg_id == code)
    )
}


included_practices <- function() {
  included_practice_status() |>
    # exclude unopen, dormat and pratcices with list_size < 1000
    filter(
      month_status == "open",
      status_code_label != "Dormant",
      total_list_size >= 1000
    ) |>
    select(code, month, total_list_size, ccg_id) |>
    left_join(
      df_ccgs |> select(code, regional_team_id, stp_id),
      by = join_by(ccg_id == code)
    )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: combine_data_sets
#| include: false

combine_data <- function(drug) {
  df <- get(glue("df_{drug}_practice"))

  df_strength <- df |>
    distinct(strength)

  df_included_practices <- included_practices() |>
    crossing(df_strength)

  ### add chemical name from df_chemical_names_
  df2 <- df |>
    inner_join(
      get(glue("df_chemical_names_{drug}")),
      by = join_by(bnf_code == presentation_code)
    )
  ### warn if rows added or removed
  if (nrow(df2) != nrow(df)) {
    print(glue("df mismatch bnf: df {nrow(df)}, df2 {nrow(df2)}"))
  }

  df2 <- df2 |>
    summarise(
      items = sum(items),
      chemical = last(chemical),
      .by = c(month, regional_team, stp, practice, strength)
    )

  ### add practice info from df_included_practices
  df3 <- df2 |>
    right_join(
      df_included_practices,
      by = join_by(month, strength, practice == code)
    )

  df3 <- df3 |>
    fill(c(regional_team, stp), .direction = "downup", .by = practice) |>
    fill(chemical, .direction = "downup") |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(
      regional_team = case_when(
        is.na(regional_team) ~ regional_team_id,
        .default = regional_team
      ),
      stp = case_when(is.na(stp) ~ stp_id, .default = stp),
      items = replace_na(items, 0)
    ) |>
    select(-ccg_id, -regional_team_id)

  df3
}
```


```{r}
#| label: non-prescribing practices
#| include: false

df_nonprescribed <- function(drug, ...) {
  combine_data(drug) |>
    summarise(
      items = sum(items),
      total_list_size = mean(total_list_size),
      .by = c(month, practice, ...)
    ) |>
    filter(items == 0)
}

missed_population <- function(drug, ...) {
  df <- df_nonprescribed(drug, ...) |>
    summarise(
      total_list_size = sum(total_list_size),
      .by = c(month, ...)
    )
}

nonprescribing_practices <- function(drug, ...) {
  df <- df_nonprescribed(drug, ...) |>
    count(month, .by = ...) %>%
    rename(n_practices = n)
  df
}
```

```{r}
#| label: dormant
#| eval: false
dormant_practices <- function(status_label) {
  included_practice_status() |>
    # exclude unopen, dormat and pratcices with list_size < 1000
    filter(
      month_status == "open",
      status_code_label == status_label,
      total_list_size >= 1000
    ) |>
    select(code, month, total_list_size, ccg_id) |>
    left_join(
      df_ccgs |> select(code, regional_team_id, stp_id),
      by = join_by(ccg_id == code)
    )
}


combine_data_dormant <- function(drug, status_label) {
  df <- get(glue("df_{drug}_practice"))

  df_strength <- df |>
    distinct(strength)

  df_included_practices <- dormant_practices(status_label) |>
    crossing(df_strength)

  ### add chemical name from df_chemical_names_
  df2 <- df |>
    inner_join(
      get(glue("df_chemical_names_{drug}")),
      by = join_by(bnf_code == presentation_code)
    )
  ### warn if rows added or removed
  if (nrow(df2) != nrow(df)) {
    print(glue("df mismatch bnf: df {nrow(df)}, df2 {nrow(df2)}"))
  }

  df2 <- df2
  ### add practice info from df_included_practices
  df3 <- df2 |>
    right_join(
      df_included_practices,
      by = join_by(month, strength, practice == code)
    ) %>%
    select(-bnf_name)

  df3 |>
    fill(c(regional_team, stp), .direction = "downup", .by = practice) |>
    fill(chemical, .direction = "downup") |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(
      regional_team = case_when(
        is.na(regional_team) ~ regional_team_id,
        .default = regional_team
      ),
      stp = case_when(is.na(stp) ~ stp_id, .default = stp),
      items = replace_na(items, 0)
    ) |>
    select(-bnf_code, -ccg_id, -regional_team_id)
}

df_dormant <- combine_data_dormant("tirzepatide", "Dormant")

## number of dormant practices 60
df_dormant |> distinct(practice) |> nrow()

df_dormant_all <- df_dormant |> count(month) %>% rename(n_practices = n)

df_dormant_months <- df_dormant_all |>
```

```{r}
#| label: icb-level
#| include: false

icb_level_data <- function(drug, ...) {
  ## aggregate to stp level
  df <- combine_data(drug) |>
    left_join(df_stp_names, by = join_by(stp == code)) |>
    rename(icb_code = stp, icb_name = name) |>
    summarise(
      items = sum(items),
      total_list_size = sum(total_list_size),
      rateper1000 = items / total_list_size * 1000,
      .by = c(month, ...)
    )

  df
}


df_orlistat_icb_strength <- icb_level_data(
  "orlistat",
  icb_code,
  icb_name,
  regional_team,
  strength
)

df_orlistat_icb <- icb_level_data("orlistat", icb_code, icb_name, regional_team)

df_tirzepatide_icb_strength <- icb_level_data(
  "tirzepatide",
  icb_code,
  icb_name,
  regional_team,
  strength
)

df_tirzepatide_icb <- icb_level_data(
  "tirzepatide",
  icb_code,
  icb_name,
  regional_team
)

df_tirzepatide_england <- icb_level_data("tirzepatide")

df_tirzepatide_england_strength <- icb_level_data("tirzepatide", strength)
```
